meta.title: Kisumu County indicators (held: not on the site until Kisumu is published)
meta.scope: Kisumu County (042): poverty, household survey, water utility, fisheries and statistical-abstract values.
meta.rule: Values as printed, each with source, publication date, period, unit, confidence, table, row, column and PDF page, read from the text layer and checked against the rendered page image by Takwimu. Survey estimates, official statistics, publisher claims and proposed targets are kept apart (field kind). Bounded values such as "<1" keep the bound. Conflicts sit side by side and are never averaged; gaps are listed, never filled. Every value is provisional until a reviewer approves it.

gaps.what: Kisumu County Lake Victoria fish landings, 2013-2024 (KeFS Fisheries Annual Statistics 2024, Table 3 and Figure 6)
gaps.reason: Publisher PDF not retrievable with valid TLS (certificate expired 2026-09-14); no other copy found. The KNBS Kisumu Statistical Abstract 2024 has cage and pond fish tables but no capture-landings table.
attempts: 2026-11-28: https://kefs.go.ke/sites/default/files/2025-07/Fisheries%20Annual%20Statistics%202024.pdf - TLS refused: the server sends only its leaf certificate (issuer emSign SSL CA - G1); with the intermediate fetched from the issuer the chain verifies but the certificate expired on 2026-09-14 (notAfter Sep 14 04:25:45 2026 GMT). Not bypassed.
2026-11-28: Internet Archive availability API: no snapshot of the file; web.archive.org CDX connection reset through the proxy.

2026-11-28: web search for other copies: only kefs.go.ke hosts the file (the 2023 bulletin, the 2024 draft bulletin and the 2025 bulletin are on the same host). prototypes.chemuagencies.com is a vendor prototype, excluded as untrusted.
gaps.next_action: As for Siaya: obtain the original PDF, hash it, read Table 3. Kisumu rows stay in this held file.

gaps.what: Sub-county poverty for Kisumu (Mapping Poverty Report in Kenya: Seme 59.7%, Muhoroni 26.0%, 445k poor)
gaps.reason: Only an unofficial copy (fliphtml5.com) was named in the handover; no KNBS release located. Quarantined: not entered, and not to be combined with the KCHS 2022 count of 478 thousand poor.
